references.text: Both verses describe boundaries that go toward the sea (westward), with similar language about the endpoint of the boundary.
The preceding verse in the same boundary description mentions several of the same cities in the territory of the tribe of Asher.
Mentions Akzib (אַכְזִיב) as one of the cities where the Canaanites still lived, the same place mentioned here.
Tyre (צֹר) is mentioned as a fortified city, the same fortified city referred to here.
Prophecy against Tyre (צֹר), the same fortified city mentioned in the boundary description.
Further prophecy about Tyre as a coastal city, the same fortified city that marks the boundary of Asher.
